component.name: Muzikette
component.summary: Keep a music library in order

description.p: Muzikette finds what needs attention in a music library and fixes it. Every change is previewed first, the originals are backed up, and everything can be undone.

ul.li: Find albums missing cover art and apply covers found on Bandcamp, Deezer and the Cover Art Archive
Credit each album's songs to its main artist, or rename an artist across the whole library
Health checks for missing titles and album artists, extra or oversized pictures, low-bitrate albums and duplicates
Organize: convert lossless files to MP3 320, standardize tags and artwork, and sort files into Artist and Album folders
Add albums and songs from YouTube Music, and replace low-bitrate songs

description.p: It looks like a piece of hi-fi equipment, in a brushed Silver or a Black finish that follows the system.

screenshot.caption: Albums, with covers found online for the selected album
A new cover ready to apply, in the Black finish
Artists: guest credits collapsed into the album's main artist
Health: what needs attention, each with a fix
Organize: presets and options, previewed before anything changes

description.p: Muzikette is available for macOS too, and Ctrl+R rescans the library.
Muzikette runs on Linux, as an AppImage that updates itself or as a Flatpak. FFmpeg, yt-dlp and Deno can be set up from inside the app there too.
Zoom with Ctrl and the mouse wheel or Ctrl with plus and minus, and the app's own title bar on Windows.
Music Library Manager is now Muzikette, with a new look and reworked pages.
